topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Rain kept falling, just like the minutes, dripping into the cracks of my day. Had a call from a guy named Joe. Said he was stuck in some airport halfway across the country, his flight delayed, punching holes in the sky. Couldn't get back in time for his daughter’s wedding. He was telling me this like maybe I could storm the clouds and make the planes run on time. Told him I know the feeling, the way time stretches when you're idling. Said I wished him luck, but I ain't much of a lucky charm. Just a guy in a rain-soaked city, where the streets keep getting longer, and the phones keep ringing with the weight of all the things we can’t change.
